topHook: The front desk is at lunch. The phone isn't.

scenes.vo: [calm] The front desk is at lunch, and the phone is ringing again. In one dental group of twenty-six practices, thirty-eight percent of incoming calls in one month went unanswered.
scenes.label: of incoming calls unanswered (one 26-practice dental group, Feb 2026)
scenes.visual: Empty reception desk, ringing phone, sandwich on the counter

scenes.vo: That's vendor data, from a case study by Peerlogic.
scenes.label: Vendor case study (Peerlogic)

scenes.vo: More than one in three calls.
[lowered] And a missed call doesn't always get a call back.
Maybe nobody was ignoring the phone. Maybe the front desk was checking someone in.
But a caller who can't get through might book somewhere else.
[quiet] An instant text back to every missed call means every caller hears back. Want your missed calls checked? Comment LEAK, it's free. Because
scenes.visual: Text bubble pops; back to the lunch scene (loop)
